Playbook.name: Windows — Credential Theft: Registry Hive or NTDS.dit Extraction - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: A command line indicative of registry-hive (SAM/SYSTEM/SECURITY) or NTDS.dit extraction ran - reg save, esentutl, ntdsutil, or vssadmin copy of the AD database. Triage question: is this credential dumping, or a legitimate backup/DR operation?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Extracting these hives/NTDS.dit yields offline-crackable credentials for the whole domain.

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Windows Security + Sysmon + PowerShell logs via Elastic Agent (verified live). Sysmon event.code 1=process(command_line/parent populated), 11=file, 13/12=registry(registry.path populated); process.code_signature NOT collected.

Signal.Name: Hive/NTDS extraction
Signal.Details: reg save of HKLM hives, esentutl/ntdsutil on ntds.dit, or vss copy.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the evidence story, not any single fact - see ClassificationGuidance.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the hive/NTDS extraction is credential dumping or a sanctioned backup/DR task.

Step.name: Confirm the extraction command
Step.Purpose: The exact command shows the target (SAM vs NTDS.dit) and method (reg save/esentutl/ntdsutil).
Step.Query: FROM logs-windows.sysmon_operational-*,logs-system.security-* | WHERE event.code IN ("1","4688") AND host.name == "$hostname" AND process.command_line IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | EVAL cl = TO_LOWER(process.command_line) | WHERE (cl LIKE "*save*" AND (cl LIKE "*hklm*sam*" OR cl LIKE "*hklm*system*" OR cl LIKE "*hklm*security*")) OR cl LIKE "*ntds.dit*" OR (cl LIKE "*esentutl*" AND cl LIKE "*ntds*") OR (cl LIKE "*ntdsutil*" AND cl LIKE "*ifm*") | KEEP @timestamp, process.name, process.parent.name, user.name, process.command_line | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 20
Step.AnalystNotes: reg save HKLM\SAM on a workstation = credential dumping. ntdsutil ... ifm on a DC = full AD database export (Golden Ticket prep) unless it is a sanctioned DR operation. Note the account and host role.

Step.name: Process origin and account on the host
Step.Purpose: The parent process and account reveal whether this was interactive attacker activity or an automated/service context.
Step.Query: FROM logs-windows.sysmon_operational-*,logs-system.security-* | WHERE event.code IN ("1","4688") AND host.name == "$hostname" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 2 hours | STATS runs = COUNT(*), parents = VALUES(process.parent.name), users = VALUES(user.name) BY process.name | SORT runs DESC | LIMIT 15
Step.AnalystNotes: A suspicious process spawned by an office app/browser/script interpreter, run by a normal user, is more concerning than one under a known admin/automation parent.

Node.Condition: Extraction of SAM/SYSTEM or NTDS.dit on a non-DC or by a non-admin, outside a backup/DR window.
Node.Result: True Positive (Credential Dumping - IR immediately, treat domain secrets as exposed)

Node.Condition: A DC backup/DR operation (ntdsutil IFM) by a known admin under a change record.
Extraction command with unclear operational context.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-NTDS-CMD, INV-02-PROC-TREE to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: A sanctioned backup/DR or migration operation.

SOCAction.Item: Verify the DR/backup task; close as false_positive.

TruePositive.Definition: Credential dumping of hives / the AD database.

Indicators.Item: reg save of HKLM hives / NTDS.dit copy on an unexpected host.

SOCAction.Item: Isolate the host; open IR; treat extracted credentials (up to whole domain if NTDS.dit) as exposed.
Rotate krbtgt x2 and reset broadly if NTDS.dit was taken.

Misconfiguration.Definition: A backup tool copying hives as part of a system image.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Confirm the activity on the host; if malicious indicators, isolate the host.
Identify the responsible account/process and its origin.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Isolate the host; capture volatile evidence; hunt the same pattern across the estate.
Reset credentials used on the host if compromise is confirmed.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Remediate the root cause; add/verify EDR coverage; apply relevant hardening.

QualityChecks.Check: Confirm the required telemetry (Sysmon/Security auditing) is present on the host.
Tune known-benign administrative sources via exceptions, not by disabling the rule.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Host contained and triaged; root cause eradicated; estate swept; findings recorded.
